strip.argument: Nonnegative representation coefficients and a_1=1 exclude Epstein zeros to the right. The entire completed functional equation reflects this exclusion. F=(s-1)E/2 cancels the pole at 1; no negative integral gamma pole lies in this strip.

scope: Complete only below the stated height; no global steepest-zero claim. Uses classical primitive-character functional equations and Arb, not a Lean analytic formalization.
